s: Most people mow on weekends
Hyped drops resell for less than quiet ones, because everyone who bought them was planning to flip them too
Club soccer before age 12 should not exist. It burns kids out and mostly sells parents hope.
Sourdough takes longer to make than regular bread
Clients who book recurring walks cancel less often than one-off bookings, which suggests they think of it as a routine and not a favor
Posting every day is a trap: small shops should post twice a week and spend the rest of the time answering comments, and anyone who tells you otherwise is selling a scheduling tool
Prices for filament dropped after more brands entered the market
Students who ask for tutoring late in the semester are usually not behind on content but behind on confidence
Selling stickers on Etsy is a worse business than selling them at school events, and marketplaces mostly train sellers to compete on price
Fortnite has a battle pass
Rainy days bring fewer customers but bigger orders, because office workers send one person out to buy for the whole team
The good stuff at yard sales is gone by nine because the early-morning buyers are mostly resellers, not neighbors
Customers who came in for a cracked screen come back for other repairs more than anyone else, because once they trust a shop with their phone they stop shopping around
Servers with strict building rules keep players longer than anything-goes servers, because the rules protect the stuff players spent hours building
Big discounts bring in customers who never come back, because they picked you for the price and not the work
Beginner YouTubers should ignore the algorithm completely; chasing it is the reason most small channels sound the same
Dropshipping is a bad first business for teenagers, and schools that teach it as entrepreneurship are teaching arbitrage, not building something
Tutoring companies that promise better grades are selling something they cannot deliver, because grades mostly come from effort the tutor does not control
Selling paid ranks ruins a server; once you sell advantages, the players who stay are the ones who paid, and they stop inviting friends
Instagram followers are close to worthless for a home bakery; every repeat customer I have came from someone tasting a sample
PSA grades cards on a 10-point scale
Etsy charges sellers a fee for each listing
Coffee shops near high schools get busier right after the last bell
